key.name: intellihide
key.description: Whether to intelligently hide the top bar

key.name: hide-from-windows
key.description: Only hide the bar when windows overlap it

key.name: hide-from-monitor-windows
key.summary: Only hide from windows on monitor
key.description: Only hide from windows on the same monitor

key.name: behaviour
key.description: Which windows to consider when determining overlap

key.name: use-pointer
key.description: Moving the mouse pointer to the top edge reveals the bar

key.name: use-pressure
key.description: Pressure must be applied to the screen edge to reveal the bar

key.name: pressure-threshold
key.description: The pressure needed to reveal the bar

key.name: pressure-time
key.description: Duration in milliseconds that pressure must be applied

key.name: revealed-hover
key.description: Keep the bar visible while the mouse pointer is over it

key.name: show-in-fullscreen
key.description: Allow the bar to be revealed while an application is in fullscreen

key.name: show-on-notification
key.description: Reveal the bar when a notification arrives

key.name: animation-time
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the hide/reveal animation

key.name: close-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before hiding the bar

key.name: reveal-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before revealing the bar

key.name: enable-start-delay
key.description: Delay before enabling intellihide on startup

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle the top bar
